coverage.note: National only. Year x NCHS 113-cause list x {Sex | Race}, from D76 (1999-2020) + D176 provisional (2021+). WONDER suppresses subgroup cells with 1-9 deaths, so rarer causes have missing subgroups. Compare on the age-adjusted rate — crude rate mostly reflects age structure.
